continuity_scope: Terms-only rules/product audit bound to the official D&D Beyond 2024 Basic Rules (published September 1, 2024) and the official SRD 5.2 licensing witness. This is not a single fictional setting or continuity; no Forgotten Realms, Greyhawk, Dragonlance, or other setting material is silently included.

work_or_witnesses.work: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024), Character Origins

coverage_rule: No characters are included. The authoritative witness profiles player-character construction options and rules categories, rather than individually named dramatic characters. Species, classes, backgrounds, alignments, spells, monsters, items, planes, and mechanics remain terms/dimensions.
omissions: All named setting, adventure, novel, game, campaign, and example characters not directly profiled by this rules witness.
All setting-specific lore, monsters, items, spells, planes, subclasses, and optional rules beyond the small rules-category terminology retained below.
Legacy 2014-rule claims except where the 2024 witness explicitly directs users to older books; no conversion compatibility details are inferred.
Unofficial third-party rules, fan wikis, Open Game License assumptions, and rules errata not expressly present in the selected witness.
uncertainties: D&D Beyond's digital rules may be revised; this audit is dated to the selected 2024 Basic Rules witness and last-reviewed date, not an assertion that all live digital text is immutable.
‘Species’ is the 2024 Basic Rules term. Older D&D products may use different terminology, including ‘race’; those are edition-specific and not silently treated as identical.
The Basic Rules allow Dungeon Master-supplied options and refer to older books for some selections; such optional/material-specific content is out of scope.
SRD 5.2 licensing is recorded as publication context only. It does not itself establish that every D&D product, setting, trademark, or rule is freely reusable.
evidence_basis: Official D&D Beyond rules establish the 2024 date, character origin, species, background, and build-rule terminology. The official SRD document provides the licensing witness. Neither profiles named dramatic individuals, so no character or relationship records are warranted.

citations.locator: Official 2024 Basic Rules table of contents and publication date
supports: Selected rules edition/date and rules-category scope.
